messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a 'staged rollback' flow in the Rollouts UI. Idea: auto-step back to previous model variant when configured signals fire (error spike, latency SLO drop, quality regression). Sketch attached. Thoughts?

aj: Love the idea. Quick q: which signals are first-class? error_rate, latency, or quality eval diffs? Also customers on strict quotas will want different thresholds.

jamie: +1. Also we should surface the degrade mode: full rollback (previous model), gentle-degrade (smaller model / cheaper quantized variant), or throttle (rate-limit). UX needs to show which action was executed and why.

teo: From runtime: we can emit 1m/5m error_rate, p95/p99 latency, token_cost_avg, and custom eval hooks. Important: debounce window to avoid flapping (suggest 2 consecutive windows by default).

rachel: Audit trail requirements: decision timestamp, triggering metric snapshot, small anonymized request sample, and who/what (auto vs manual) initiated the change. Storage/retention question — can't keep raw payloads forever.

nick: config proposal (very rough):

```json
{"triggers": [{"metric": "error_rate", "window_s": 300, "threshold": 0.02, "op": ">", "action": "rollback"}], "debounce": 2, "mode": "auto", "dry_run": false}
```

We should support multiple triggers with AND/OR semantics.

maria: UX options: simple toggle (enable auto-rollback + one slider for threshold) vs advanced JSON editor for power users. Also add 'dry run' toggle to let teams validate decisions without enforcement.

aj: Permissioning note: only org-admins should be allowed to enable enforced auto-rollback. Developers can enable dry-run. Also show an obvious banner when auto-policy is active.

jamie: Another edge case — if infra/region is failing, rollback to previous model won't help. We should include signal provenance in the decision UI (model vs infra vs region) and allow routing fallback instead.

teo: On the wire we can attach `signal_source` = ['model','infra','region'] plus `decision_reason` string so the console can filter & explain.

deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-18T11:03:22Z started for model v3 on dedicated pool 'eu-west-1'

rachel: :thumbsup: propose adding an 'audit snapshot' export (CSV + anonymized sample) on triggered events, with retention options (7/30/90 days). We'll coordinate with infra for storage cost estimates.

maria: Action items I will own: 1) @aj — mockups for simple vs advanced UX by EOD Fri. 2) @teo & @jamie — spec of signal list + debounce semantics. 3) @rachel — retention + PII/redaction constraints for audit samples. 4) @nick — draft config schema PR for platform API. I'll consolidate into an RFC next week.

aj: sgtm

teo: on it

jamie: will add routing caveats to spec

nick: starting PR now, will include example validation errors and migration notes

rachel: I'll loop in security about redaction rules and compliance needs

maria: Thanks all — feel free to drop quick notes here if anything else pops up.
